# Nino Salvaggio International Marketplace

> > Award-winning metro Detroit grocery chain offering fresh international produce, gourmet catering, gift baskets, and a loyalty rewards program across Southeast Michigan locations.

Nino Salvaggio is a family-owned international marketplace with four locations in the Detroit area, known for premium fresh produce, specialty items, and community engagement. The site features an online shop, catering services, recipes, and customer loyalty programs.

## Key Topics

- Fresh Rewards loyalty program
- Catering and party planning
- Gift baskets and gourmet gifts
- International marketplace
- Southeast Michigan locations
- Fresh produce and specialty items
- Deli and butcher services
- Online shopping
- Recipes and cooking guides
- Local delivery
- Store locations (St. Clair Shores, Troy, Clinton Township, Bloomfield Township)
- Customer service
- Gift cards
- Nino Salvaggio Foundation
- Italian heritage

## Shop & Products

- [Nino Salvaggio - Shop](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/shop): Main online shop for groceries, gifts, catering via Fresh2Go and Deli 1-2-3
- [International Market](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/products): International marketplace with produce, butcher, seafood, bakery, and specialty items
- [Trays and platters to go in Southeast Michigan - Nino Salvaggio](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/shop/trays-platters-to-go): Catering platters and trays for events across Southeast Michigan locations
- [Handcrafted gift baskets are a tradition at Nino's - Nino Salvaggio](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/shop/gift-baskets): Handcrafted gift baskets with gourmet items, fruit, wine, and specialty baskets
- [Nino Salvaggio - Gift Baskets](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/shop/gift-baskets/best-sellers): Curated gift baskets with fresh fruits, cheeses, and gourmet items
- [Nino Salvaggio - Gift Cards](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/shop/gift-cards): Gift cards redeemable at all Nino Salvaggio Southeastern Michigan stores

## Savings & Loyalty

- [Rewards and special savings on groceries - Nino Salvaggio](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/save/fresh-rewards): Fresh Rewards loyalty program with member-exclusive discounts and benefits
- [Marketplace Specials: offers on groceries - Nino Salvaggio](https://www.ninosalvaggio.com/save/marketplace-specials): Weekly specials and deals on fresh produce, meat, deli, and grocery essentials
